g.text: Single-phase and six-pulse bridges select the highest source potential for DC positive

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal uncontrolled bridges with continuous source voltage, no source inductance, commutation overlap, diode drop or output filter. Six-pulse waveform is
max(v_a,v_b,v_c)−min(v_a,v_b,v_c); phase peak is normalization1. Mean six-pulse DC=3√2 V_LL,rms/π≈1.3505V_LL,rms. Lower return diode connects DC− to the minimum
phase. Single-phase bridge has two-pulse ripple2f.
